configuration.summary:
I see skills not just as items on a list, but as abilities developed through curiosity, practice, experience, and continuous learning. Some have grown through building projects, others through academic pursuits, professional responsibilities, or personal exploration.

This page brings together the technologies, tools, and areas of knowledge I've worked with, along with what each of them means to me. Where possible, I've connected a skill to the projects or milestones that helped me develop it. Others stand on their own, representing knowledge and abilities worth sharing in their own right.

More than a measure of proficiency, this is a reflection of what I've explored, what I've learned, and how I've grown along the way.
